source_information: First vertical fold-axis guide in the original square diagram
receiver: Two vertical sides of E central square aperture
use: Propose folding-axis direction as the direction of hole sides; this is the false comparison, because hole sides are reflected from the diagonal cut, not from fold guides.

source_information: Second horizontal fold-axis guide in the rectangle diagram
receiver: Two horizontal sides of E central square aperture
use: Complete the orthogonal pair of folding-axis directions wrongly used as the aperture-edge directions.
